title: lint: a view `sort` naming a field the author declared `sortable: false` clears validate, then 400s on every load once #29896 lands — `validate-sortable-fields` judges only the virtual predicate
body:
domain:server#6 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzibcN9oHa8kDbTTnL5

Filing gate: this is a seat finding from the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of PR #30021 (#29896), record 6624674350 ③, and the dev reported the same gap as out of scope. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Business reason: PR #30021 makes the Data API door refuse a sort that names a field whose author declared `sortable: false` (`400 INVALID_SORT`, reason `author-declared`). `packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.ts` keys only on the virtual-type predicate, so `os validate` / publish passes a list view whose declared `sort` names such a field. That view's first fetch, and every one after it, then answers 400. This is the same class as #9257 (a `formula` sort that clears lint and then 400s), which closed the virtual half.
Reader who acts: `domain:server`, `packages/lint`, after #30021 merges.
Dedupe (open and closed): `validate-sortable-fields`, `sortable false view sort`, `filterPlatformSortableSort`. The nearest is #9257 (closed, virtual half). **New.**

## What to do
- Judge a view `sort` entry (and any other authored sort surface that `validate-sortable-fields` already walks) against `resolveObjectSortability`'s `author-declared` verdict. Do not use a second predicate.
- The ADR-0087 semantic entry that #30021 registers for this surface names this gate as the remedy's check, so reference that entry's id.
- Real publish-route pin plus one ablation. Grade the verdict level (error vs warning) against the precedent #9257 set.

Done when a view whose `sort` names a `sortable: false` field is refused at publish with the same field and reason the door serves.
